ColonyCouncil.WorldSituationDef.label: the new head at the gate

texts.li: [succeeded] {X_nameFull} has not held the seat at {PLACE} long, and has already saddled up to see the land {X_pronoun} now speaks for. The road brings {X_objective} past the colony.\n\nWord came ahead with a rider: the new {TITLE} means to stop at the gate, with a few of {FACTION} at {X_possessive} side.

[claimed] The quarrel over the seat at {PLACE} is barely cold, and {X_nameFull} is already on the road, riding round the neighbours who will have to live with the result. The colony is on the way.\n\nA rider came ahead to say so: the new {TITLE} will stop at the gate.

[theirLowtech] {X_nameFull}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, is walking the bounds of {X_possessive} people's land, as their heads do in their first season, and the bounds pass close to the colony.\n\n{X_pronoun} will stop at the gate with a few of {X_possessive} people, the rider says, to see the neighbours with {X_possessive} own eyes.

[theirHightech] A short message from {PLACE}: {X_nameFull}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, is making a round of the region's settlements and would like to stop at the colony. {X_pronoun} will come with a small escort and will not stay long.

summaries.li: [kind] {X_nameDef} is said to be open-handed, and to remember who was kind back.
[greedy] {X_nameDef} is said to count everything twice. {X_pronoun} will want to know how the colony trades.
[harsh] {X_nameDef} is said to be quick to take offence. {X_pronoun} will be watching for how the colony receives {X_objective}.
[steady,pactTalk] {X_nameDef} is said to be careful and to think in years. {FACTION} are on good terms with the colony, and {X_pronoun} may have more than greetings in mind.
[steady,!pactTalk] {X_nameDef} is said to be careful and in no hurry. {X_pronoun} has come to look, mostly.

texts.li: [kind] {X_nameDef}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, has reached the gate with a few of {X_possessive} people and is waiting there, looking the colony over with open interest. {X_pronoun} has asked after the colony's harvest and its children before anyone thought to ask after {X_possessive} journey.

[greedy] {X_nameDef}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, is at the gate with a few of {X_possessive} people. {X_pronoun} has already had a look at the colony's walls and its sheds, and the first thing {X_pronoun} asked was what the colony sells, what it buys, and at what prices.

[harsh] {X_nameDef}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, stands at the colony's gate with a few of {X_possessive} people and has not dismounted. {X_pronoun} is waiting to see how the colony receives the head of {FACTION}, and {X_possessive} people are watching for any slight.
[steady] {X_nameDef}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, has stopped at the gate with a few of {X_possessive} people. {X_pronoun} is in no hurry, looks at everything, and says little until spoken to.

[steady,pactTalk] {X_nameDef}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, has stopped at the gate with a few of {X_possessive} people. {X_pronoun} has said, plainly, that {FACTION} and the colony have done well by each other, and that {X_pronoun} would like to talk about doing better.

li.label: Sit them at the table, with {A_nameDef} hosting
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} brings {X_nameDef} and {X_possessive} people in to supper from the colony's stores, and beds are found for them for the night.

outcomes.li: [kind] {A_nameDef} brings {X_nameDef} and {X_possessive} people in to supper and finds them beds for the night. Before sitting down, {X_nameDef} has a gift of {X_possessive} own carried in from the horses.
[harsh] {A_nameDef} brings {X_nameDef} in to the colony's table with every courtesy, and {X_nameDef} gets down from the saddle at last. A seat at the table was what {X_pronoun} wanted to see.

li.label: Give a gift from the stores ({COUNT} silver)
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carries the gift out to {X_nameDef} at the gate, with the colony's greetings to the new {TITLE}.

outcomes.li: [greedy] {A_nameDef} carries the silver out to {X_nameDef} at the gate. {X_nameDef} weighs the purse in {X_possessive} hand before thanking {A_objective}, and the thanks are warm.
[kind] {A_nameDef} carries the gift out to {X_nameDef}, who takes it with thanks and has a gift of {X_possessive} own handed over in return.

li.deed: gave {X_nameDef} a gift at the gate

li.label: A word at the gate from {A_nameDef}
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} goes out to the gate and talks with {X_nameDef} a while, and {X_nameDef} rides on afterwards.

outcomes.li: [harsh] {A_nameDef} goes out to the gate and says the colony's greetings. {X_nameDef} hears {A_objective} out from the saddle, says little, and rides on. A word at the gate was not what {X_pronoun} came for.
[kind] {A_nameDef} goes out and talks with {X_nameDef} at the gate a while. {X_nameDef} leaves a gift of {X_possessive} own all the same, and rides on.

texts.li: [table] {X_nameDef} has gone home to {PLACE}, and the talk there is of the supper at the colony and of {A_nameDef}, who kept the new {TITLE} at the table till late. {FACTION} will remember who sat them down.
[table,invited] {X_nameDef} has gone home to {PLACE}. The colony asked {X_objective} to its next feast with guests before {X_pronoun} left, and {X_pronoun} said {X_pronoun} would come.
[gift] {X_nameDef} has ridden home to {PLACE} with the colony's gift, and {FACTION} have heard of it.

[gift,greedy] {X_nameDef} has ridden home to {PLACE} with the colony's silver, and the colony's name has gone into {X_possessive} book among the friends worth trading with. A caravan of {FACTION} has already been sent along the road.
[word,!harsh] {X_nameDef} has ridden on to the next of {FACTION}'s neighbours. The colony gave {X_objective} a civil word at the gate, and that was enough for a first meeting.
[word,harsh] {X_nameDef} has ridden on, and {FACTION} have heard that the colony kept their new {TITLE} standing at the gate. It will be remembered at {PLACE}, and not kindly.
[kindGift] {X_nameDef} has gone home to {PLACE}, and the gift {X_pronoun} left at the gate is in the colony's stores. {FACTION} have a head who gives first and asks after.
[pactOffered] {X_nameDef} has gone home to {PLACE} and kept {X_possessive} word: {FACTION}'s offer of a trade pact has come by letter, for the colony to take or leave.
{X_nameDef} has gone home to {PLACE}, and the colony knows a little better who now leads {FACTION}.

li.chronicle: {X_nameDef}, the new {TITLE} of {FACTION}, stopped at the colony's gate.
